top_choice_rationale: P002 honours Buchwald and Hartwig for palladium-catalysed C-N cross-coupling: a general, mature method with verifiable routine use in medicinal and process chemistry, clean two-name credit (Kosugi's tin-amide chemistry was not general), and a new bond class needing distinct mechanistic solutions (amine binding, deprotonation, C-N reductive elimination via ligand design), so not a mere refinement of the 2010 C-C coupling prize. P001 (PROTAC and cereblon) is a strong, defensible second whose mechanism is well established, but its credit is split across different discoverers and its impact is still partly prospective. Either award is preferable to no award.
